About the Health Career Display event

Health Career Display is a Teamwork event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the two-person HOSA Health Career Display event, following the 2026–27 guidelines: choosing and researching one health career, describing its responsibilities, education, entry-level salary at local, national and global levels, benefits and challenges, designing a compliant 36″ × 48″ tri-fold display, building the 16-slide Round One digital outline (110 points), the Required Project Display Time and the five-minute Round Two presentation (115 points). Includes career-sorting, design and compliance drills, timing plans and practice scenarios.
